title: Fix periodService.test.ts mock type errors - axios mock methods not typed
description:
Fix axios mock method type errors in periodService.test.ts.

**Problem:**
vi.mock('axios') doesn't preserve mock method types. Calls like:
- api.get.mockResolvedValue(...)
- api.post.mockResolvedValue(...)
fail with TS2339: Property 'mockResolvedValue' does not exist.

**Affected File:**
- src/services/__tests__/periodService.test.ts (17 errors, lines 23-338)

**Solution:**
Use proper vi.mock typing:
```typescript
import { vi, type Mock } from 'vitest'

vi.mock('@/utils/axios', () => ({
  api: {
    get: vi.fn(),
    post: vi.fn(),
  }
}))

// Then use:
const mockGet = api.get as Mock
mockGet.mockResolvedValue({ data: ... })
```

Or use vi.mocked() helper:
```typescript
vi.mocked(api.get).mockResolvedValue({ data: ... })
```

**Done When:**
- [ ] All axios mock calls properly typed
- [ ] No TS2339 errors for mock methods
- [ ] periodService tests pass
